blocks.text: BACOLOD CITY, NEGROS OCCIDENTAL, Philippines — Stepping up for a children’s home in dire need of financial support, “Mr. Pure Energy” Gary Valenciano is in Negros Occidental to raise funds for the Kalipay Negrense Foundation and inspire local youth through music and personal talks. He visited Recovered Treasures: A Kalipay Home in Bago City on Thursday morning, where he sang and danced with its children. Kalipay cares for 108 kids in the home and 80 children in the community and is in dire need of help to make ends meet, its president Anna Balcells said. Valenciano is in Negros for a […]...
